causalImpacts.annotation: LessWrong was one of the original three intellectual communities that fed into early EA, along with the Oxford utilitarians who were influenced by Parfit, and GiveWell coming out of Birdgewater

The ideas that Yudkowsky promoted, and which were discussed on LessWrong, lead directly to the founding of OpenAI: Elon Musk reads Superintelligence and attends the Puerto Rico conference, and then founds OpenAI with Sam Altman as a counterweight to Google DeepMind
